milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the snow block structure (centered at approximately 0,2,8 relative to spawn) and face toward it. max_distance=16 allows detection from approach distance, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the structure. This correctly models 'player can see the snow blocks'.

Uses inventory_has because when a trapped_chest is mined it drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The player does not start with any trapped_chest in inventory, so having min_count=1 confirms the chest was successfully mined. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.
